label: databricks: bundle validate
command: echo "▶ bundle target: $(printenv DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET || echo '<bundle default>') | profile: $(printenv DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE || echo '<DEFAULT>')" && databricks bundle validate
